start_test_server: start an optillm server on a free port for integration testing with a specified model
stop_test_server: stop a running optillm test server process by terminating and waiting for cleanup
get_integration_config: get a preconfigured OpenEvolve config object tuned for fast CI integration tests with optillm
find_free_port: find an available TCP port on localhost starting from a given port number
get_test_client: get an OpenAI client configured to connect to a local optillm server
